name: The Wise Men
title: The Wise Men from the East
summary: The wise men from the East followed a star to Jerusalem to find the newborn king of the Jews. They worshiped the child Jesus in Bethlehem and gave him gold, frankincense, and myrrh, before returning home by another route to avoid Herod.

keyEvents.title: Worship the Child Jesus
keyEvents.description: The wise men followed the star to Bethlehem, worshiped the child, and gave it gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
